title: 第13章 与勇者同行第14章 勇者傻逼
slug: 我妈等着治病你召唤我当勇者
content_zh:
一众的勇者走在城主府的走廊上，接连回到自己单独的房间。
到最后，走廊上只剩下了王同和苏琳两人。
王同这才不满地抱怨道：“苏老师，你刚才为什么要替法诺城主说话啊？这趟废弃矿洞要是没有技能奖励，那我们不就是白去一趟吗？”
苏琳叹了口气，停下脚步。
语气带着一丝无奈：“王同，你现在再逼他有什么用？风狼王已经死了，技能精髓被人拿走了，你把他逼急了，对我们有什么好处？”
“可是……”
王同还想争辩。
苏琳打断了他，压低声音道：“至于技能精髓，倒也不用咱们太担心。你真以为他一个城主，会连一个备用的技能精髓都拿不出来吗？”
王同一愣，有些不解：“什么意思？”
苏琳冷静地分析道：“你想想，我们刚被召唤来的时候，他就一人给了一个技能精髓。这些技能精髓大概都是他买来的。他只要愿意出钱，随时都能再弄到几个，我们现在逼他，只会让他心生反感，不如以退为进。”
王同恍然大悟，点了点头：“原来如此，还是苏老师你想得周到。”
随即，他精神一振，脸上重新露出自信的笑容。
“到时候我也肯定会是咱们这批人里第一个升到11级的！”
苏琳看着他自信满满的样子，勉强笑了笑：“是啊，咱们这20个人里，就属你升级最快。当初在班里，你也是体育委员，身体素质最好。”
他们两人是一块被召唤来的。
在召唤到这个世界之前，他们还是师生正在上课。
王同嘿嘿一笑，凑近了些。
带着点炫耀的语气低声道：“苏老师，告诉你个秘密，我已经……10级了。”
“10级？”
苏琳猛地瞪大眼睛，难以置信地看着他，“你……你不是昨天还跟城主汇报说只有9级吗？”

王同撇了撇嘴，一副理所当然的样子：“那是我保存实力，不想太早暴露底牌嘛。”
苏琳心中不免掀起惊涛骇浪。
据法诺城主所说。
能在被召唤后半个月内依靠自身升级达到10级的勇者，都意味着拥有极强的天赋。
击杀魔物时能转化吸收的经验值效率远超常人。
她自己作为最后一个被召唤来的，拼尽全力，到现在也不过8级。
20个勇者里也只有3个人等级到了9级。
昨晚她之所以冒险独自进入风狼领地，就是为了能多升一点经验。
好在今天的废弃矿洞中多杀几只蜘蛛。
她万万没想到，王同竟然不声不响地达到了10级！
这份天赋和速度，确实惊人。
王同看到苏琳震惊的表情，似乎非常受用。
脸上露出一个自以为深情的笑容，说道：“苏老师，你放心，等我等级升上去，实力更强了，我一定会保护你的。”
说着，他竟伸出手，想要去拉苏琳的手。
苏琳如同触电般，猛地将手收回背到身后。
后退了半步，脸色严肃起来：“王同！注意你的言行！我们是师生关系，你想什么呢！”
王同对此却毫不在意，反而上前一步。
语气带着一丝强硬：“师生？那是被召唤以前的事了！既然我们现在一起被召唤到这个世界，就说明我们有缘分，更应该互相照应才对。而且……”
他正了正神色，目光直视着苏琳。
“实话跟你说吧，苏老师，我之前在学校的时候就喜欢你了，现在到了这个世界，你就答应我吧。”

苏琳眉头紧蹙，脸上浮现出明显的不悦和抗拒。
语气也变得冰冷：“王同！这件事到此为止，以后不许再提！”
说完，她不再给王同说话的机会，转身快步向着自己的房间方向走去。
content_en:
A group of brave men walked in the corridor of the City Lord's Mansion and returned to their separate rooms one after another.
In the end, only Wang Tong and Su Lin were left in the corridor.
Wang Tong then complained dissatisfiedly: "Teacher Su, why did you speak for the Lord of Fano City just now? If there is no skill reward for this abandoned mine, then wouldn't our trip be in vain?"
Su Lin sighed and stopped.
There was a trace of helplessness in his tone: "Wang Tong, what's the use of pushing him now? The Wind Wolf King is already dead, and the essence of his skills has been taken away. If you push him, what good will it do to us?"
"But..."
Wang Tong still wanted to argue.
Su Lin interrupted him and lowered her voice: "As for the skill essence, we don't need to worry too much. Do you really think that he, a city lord, can't even produce a spare skill essence?"
Wang Tong was stunned and a little confused: "What do you mean?"
Su Lin calmly analyzed: "Think about it, when we were first summoned, he gave each of us a skill essence. He probably bought these skill essences. As long as he is willing to pay, he can get a few more at any time. If we force him now, it will only make him feel disgusted. It is better to retreat instead of advancing."
Wang Tong suddenly understood and nodded: "I see, Teacher Su, you are so considerate."
Immediately, he refreshed and a confident smile appeared on his face again.
"When the time comes, I will definitely be the first among our group to reach level 11!"
Su Lin looked at his confident look and forced a smile: "Yes, among the 20 of us, you are the fastest to upgrade. In the class, you were also the sports committee member and had the best physical fitness."
The two of them were summoned together.
Before they were summoned to this world, they were teachers and students taking classes.
Wang Tong chuckled and moved closer.
With a bit of a show-off tone, he whispered: "Teacher Su, let me tell you a secret, I have... reached level 10."
"Level 10?"
Su Lin's eyes suddenly widened and she looked at him in disbelief, "You...didn't you report to the city lord yesterday that it was only level 9?"
Wang Tong curled his lips and said matter-of-factly: "That's because I'm conserving my strength and don't want to reveal my trump card too early."
Su Lin couldn't help but feel a storm in her heart.
According to the Lord of Fano City.
A brave man who can rely on himself to upgrade to level 10 within half a month after being summoned means that he has extremely strong talents.
The efficiency of converting and absorbing experience points when killing monsters is far beyond that of ordinary people.
As the last one to be summoned, she tried her best, but she was still only at level 8.
Only 3 of the 20 brave men have reached level 9.
The reason why she ventured into the Wind Wolf territory alone last night was just to gain more experience.
Fortunately, we killed a few more spiders in the abandoned mine today.
She never expected that Wang Tong would reach level 10 silently!
This talent and speed are truly amazing.
Wang Tong seemed to be very pleased when he saw Su Lin's shocked expression.
A smile that he thought was affectionate appeared on his face, and he said: "Teacher Su, don't worry, when my level rises and my strength becomes stronger, I will definitely protect you."
As he said that, he actually reached out his hand and wanted to grab Su Lin's hand.
Su Lin suddenly took her hands back behind her back as if she was electrocuted.
He took a half step back and his face became serious: "Wang Tong! Pay attention to your words and deeds! We are a teacher and student, what are you thinking!"
Wang Tong didn't care about this and instead took a step forward.
There was a hint of toughness in his tone: "Teacher and student? That was before we were summoned! Since we are now summoned to this world together, it means that we are destined and should take care of each other. And..."
He straightened his expression and looked directly at Su Lin.
"To tell you the truth, Teacher Su, I liked you when I was in school. Now that I'm in this world, you promise meBar. "
Su Lin frowned, with obvious displeasure and resistance on her face.
His tone also became cold: "Wang Tong! This matter ends here and is not allowed to be mentioned again! "
After saying that, she no longer gave Wang Tong a chance to speak, turned around and walked quickly towards her room.
